name: Benquerencia (Spain)
description: Square flag divided vertically red and white, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Benquerencia (a column on white and a cross of Saint James on white).
history: The arms and the flag of Benquerencia were approved by the Order of 5 December 1991 published in the Diario Oficial de Extremadura on 24 December 1991, after the municipal council's approval on 16 March 1990; the flag is square, parted red and white, with the municipal arms in its colours over all at the centre.

features.role: Benquerencia arms — column and cross of Saint James
